Chapter 736: Chapter 26: The Unyielding Supreme Being (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 736: Chapter 26: The Unyielding Supreme Being (Subscription Request)_2

Xia Qin Supreme Being immediately said,

“Just taking out the extraordinary object and giving away fifty percent of its value does seem extravagant.”

“But we must understand that if the extraordinary object isn’t taken out, it’s essentially a zero gain for human civilization.”

“And this fifty percent value is not for the Star Alliance; it’s still for our own people. Xia Qin Supreme Being is quite willing to do so.”

“No problem,”

Lin Yuan immediately said.

...

This is practically a giveaway.

“It’s just that I don’t know if I can actually enter the Heavenly Gate.”

Lin Yuan said with some hesitation.

“With your cultivation speed, as long as you avoid the Four Divine Kings and focus on the second and third openings of the Heavenly Gate, there’s still a great chance,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

“Avoid the Four Divine Kings?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred; whether in the Two-dimensional World or the Main Universe, the might of the Four Divine Kings was immense.

“Yes, the Supreme Weapon of the Four Divine Kings suits him perfectly. Even if your realm is higher and your strength greater, the overall combat power is another matter.”

“With your potential and speed of cultivation, there’s no need to compete with the Four Divine Kings. The risk would be too great,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said, shaking his head.

“Understood,”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts were already in alignment with Xia Qin Supreme Being’s.

Unless he was absolutely certain, Lin Yuan would not take risks to compete for a spot in the first opening of the Heavenly Gate.

Time was on Lin Yuan’s side. The longer the time, the greater the advantage his Against-Heaven’s Understanding would bring.

In just over a hundred years, Lin Yuan was close to catching up to those Tier 11 Perfect legendary lives. In another ten thousand years, Lin Yuan himself didn’t know to what extent he could reach.

…

“Right,”

“Since you’ve already reached the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm, our derived cultivation method won’t mean much to you. However, you can try to comprehend the essence of the power that was captured from the ‘Void Realm World’, a replica of the Two-dimensional World,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said. The essence of the power captured through the ‘Void Realm World’ was the basis for the nine Supreme Beings to derive the Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skill.

Usually, such an essence of power wouldn’t yield much insight even to those at the Tenth or Eleventh Rank of life.

But after seeing Lin Yuan’s performance, Xia Qin Supreme Being had a different opinion.

After all, letting Lin Yuan comprehend it wouldn’t be a loss anyway.

“The essence of power?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up.

In the Two-dimensional World, understanding the essence of its power was slow due to the world’s inherent suppression.

But outside, without the constraints of the Two-dimensional World, observing the essence of power could yield significant benefits.

“Right, your true body is on the Milky Way Main Star, yes? I will get Yudie to guide a thread of ‘Void Realm World’ power for your enlightenment,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

“Thank you, Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan said with great appreciation.

Having the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being run an errand like this was probably an honor few in human civilization’s history had received.

…

In the depths of the Cosmic Starry Sky,

a mysterious ‘scroll’ slowly unfurled.

Numerous towering figures stood in the vicinity.

“Xia Qin, how is it? Have you given it some thought?”

A colossal figure, stretching billions of miles high, transmitted a message to Xia Qin Supreme Being, “Your human civilization has a decent relationship with our Star Alliance. For the opening of the Heavenly Gate within the Two-dimensional World, as long as you’re willing to give up sixty percent of the extraordinary objects, I can have the Four Divine Kings bring out the extraordinary objects found by your civilization’s Evolvers. How about it?”

“This deal is very lucrative. For the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan, I demand seventy to eighty percent of the extraordinary objects.”

The colossal figure looked at Xia Qin Supreme Being, himself a Twelfth-Rank Life leading countless special beings and rivaling several Peak Clan Forces.

“I’ll give it some thought,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said calmly.

“Give it some thought?” The colossal figure was slightly startled. “Xia Qin, you weren’t like this before.”

The figure was somewhat puzzled; he had just negotiated with the Xia Qin Supreme Being not long ago, who had appeared quite enthusiastic.

But now?

The colossal figure clearly sensed a change in attitude.

“Your asking price is too high,” Xia Qin Supreme Being, now knowing Lin Yuan’s true strength, was much more confident and was only stalling the other party.

“If the price is high, we can negotiate,” the colossal figure immediately said.

“Then I’ll give it some thought,” Xia Qin Supreme Being repeated, bringing the conversation back to square one.

“Alright, you think about it,” the colossal figure said no more. “But time is limited, and if you wait too long, it won’t be just sixty percent of the extraordinary objects.”

The extraordinary objects within the Two-dimensional World had extremely concealed auras. Even for beings as powerful as the Four Divine Kings, they could only recognize them when they got close and used many methods.

Therefore… as long as the human civilization’s Evolvers hid their harvested extraordinary objects in secluded places, even if the Four Divine Kings slaughtered them all, they still wouldn’t be able to obtain the extraordinary objects.

…

Outside the Milky Way Main Star,

an ephemeral presence coalesced, taking the form of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

“This youngster, he actually cultivated to the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm?” Feather Butterfly Supreme Being looked towards the distant Milky Way Main Star, still pondering the matters Xia Qin Supreme Being had told her.

“How exactly did he cultivate? Without the high-level perspective and understanding of power of an Eleventh-Rank Life, how could he possibly have such a rapid cultivation speed?”

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was astounded yet soon smiled, “But this is good. At least in that Two-dimensional World, my human civilization now has its own Peak combat power.”

“Void Realm World…”

With a slight thought from Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, strands of ethereal power, crossing infinite light-years, descended upon the Milky Way Main Star, more precisely in the Star Lord’s Great Hall.
